select q.quote_id, q.quote_no, q.inquiry_id, q.seller_id, q.quoter_id, q.quoter_role, q.price, q.license_type, q.valid_days, q.description, q.status, q.expire_at, q.created_at, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.remark, i.inquiry_no as inquiry_no, w.title as work_title from sys_quote q left join sys_inquiry i on q.inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id left join sys_work w on i.work_id = w.work_id
AND q.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND q.quoter_role = #{quoterRole} AND q.status = #{status} AND q.quote_no like concat('%', #{quoteNo}, '%')
order by q.created_at desc

select q.*, i.inquiry_no as inquiry_no, w.title as work_title from sys_quote q left join sys_inquiry i on q.inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id left join sys_work w on i.work_id = w.work_id where q.quote_id = #{quoteId}
